findings.title: Shard-aware-miss branch drops connection without decrementing total_connections
findings.claim: In the shard-aware-port mismatch branch, a connection landing on the wrong shard is dropped and replaced via start_opening_connection(None), but unlike sibling drop sites the dec_total_connections() call is missing, so the total_connections gauge drifts permanently upward since Connection has no metrics-touching Drop.

findings.title: Keyspace setup failure log level downgraded from warn! to debug!
findings.claim: A failed USE on a new connection was logged at warn! but is now logged at debug!, only surfacing otherwise via update_shared_conns when the pool is empty and not filling; with a non-empty pool a persistent keyspace failure becomes silent at default log levels while the refiller loops open→fail→discard.

findings.title: keyspace_setup_failure_triggers_refill test asserts a condition already true before the event was handled
findings.claim: The test asserts refiller.need_filling(), but that was already true before the event was handled (empty pool, nothing in flight), so it doesn't demonstrate the 'schedules another refill' criterion; driving the event through PoolRefiller::run and observing a fresh connection attempt would.

findings.title: New tests don't call setup_tracing(), unlike rest of module, losing driver logs on CI failure
findings.claim: Neither new test calls setup_tracing(), unlike every other test in that module, so CI failures come with no driver logs.

findings.title: run() returning on a dropped use-keyspace channel leaks the whole pool's connection count
findings.claim: Pre-existing, untouched by this PR: run() returning on a dropped use-keyspace channel leaks the whole pool's count.

findings.title: Missing timeout on keyspace setup lets a hung USE wedge is_filling() forever
findings.claim: Pre-existing, untouched by this PR: the '// TODO: There should be a timeout for this' on keyspace setup means a hung USE wedges is_filling() forever.

findings.title: Pool-level use_keyspace leaves already-pooled connections on wrong keyspace on USE failure
findings.claim: Pre-existing, untouched by this PR: pool-level use_keyspace leaves already-pooled connections on the wrong keyspace when their USE fails.

findings.title: tests::many_connections requires a real cluster at SCYLLA_URI
findings.claim: Pre-existing, untouched by this PR: tests::many_connections needs a real cluster at SCYLLA_URI.

findings.title: Suspected double decrement in maybe_reshard/remove_connection does not occur
findings.claim: A candidate finding of a double decrement in maybe_reshard/remove_connection was raised and withdrawn on re-reading; it is not a problem.

findings.title: Reshard deferral behavior questioned but confirmed to be the PR's stated intent
findings.claim: A candidate finding about the reshard deferral was raised and withdrawn on re-reading; it is the PR's stated intent, not a bug.

findings.title: Suspected missing refill scheduling does not occur; refill is scheduled by run() loop bottom
findings.claim: A candidate finding that refill was not scheduled was raised and withdrawn on re-reading; the refill is scheduled by the run() loop bottom.

findings.title: Two suspected test races were raised and withdrawn; they don't occur
findings.claim: Two suspected test races were raised as candidate findings and withdrawn on re-reading; the races don't occur.
